result.summary: The pedestrian environment is currently compromised by active construction that obstructs the sidewalk and creates visual barriers at the corner. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and crosswalks exist, they are in poor condition, lack ADA-compliant curb ramps, and have faded markings.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction fencing and a portable toilet block the pedestrian walkway, forcing people into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and midground along the building site

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The corner lacks sloped transitions, making it inaccessible for wheelchairs or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The construction fencing and building placement right at the property line create a blind corner for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings.

interventions.title: Construction Site Management
interventions.description: Require the developer to maintain a clear, protected pedestrian bypass during construction.

result.summary: A residential street on a steep incline with narrow sidewalks and significantly degraded pavement. The lack of marked crossings and the presence of large construction equipment on the roadway edge create a challenging environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Parked Construction Equipment
hazards.description: A large telehandler is parked on the left side of the road, obstructing sight lines and the pedestrian path of travel where a sidewalk is absent.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no clearly marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross in an unprotected manner.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The pavement is cracked and worn, which can create tripping hazards or uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signage. The roadway surface is in poor condition with significant patching, and parked vehicles near the corners obstruct sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross the wide intersection.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and patched pavement creates uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners limit visibility between pedestrians and approaching traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to clear sightlines.
